author: Tickell, 1833
habitat: 서해 섬과 제주도의 덤불, 숲 가장자리
summary: 5월을 중심으로 서해의 섬에 드물게 찾아오는 솔새로, 2005년 5월 소청도에서 처음 기록된 뒤 백령도·가거도·어청도·제주도 등에서 거의 해마다 기록된다. 국내에 오는 것은 중국 중서부 고산에서 번식하는 아종 occisinensis 로, 한때 별개의 종으로 다루어졌다. 번식지에서는 해발 3,000m 넘는 높은 산의 버드나무·관목 덤불과 바위 사이에 살며, 덤불 속을 옮겨 다니며 곤충을 잡아먹는다.

points.en: uniform greenish-brown crown and upperparts, no crown stripe

similar.how: 담황턱솔새는 몸이 조금 작고 부리가 짧으며 부리 끝의 검은 부분이 넓고, 아랫면과 눈썹선이 맑은 노란색이 아니라 담황갈색을 띤다.

art.subject: Tickell's Leaf Warbler (Phylloscopus affinis), adult, as seen in Korea on spring migration: crown and upperparts dark olive-green with a slight brownish tone, no crown stripe; long, bright yellow supercilium from the bill base to the rear of the ear-coverts; dark olive eye-stripe; cheeks yellowish-olive; wings and tail darker olive-brown with green edges and no wing-bars; underparts bright lemon-yellow from chin to undertail, slightly olive on the flanks. Bill fine, the upper mandible dark and the lower mandible orange-yellow; dark eye; legs pale orange-brown.
art.pose: foraging low in a leafy shrub, side view
art.scene: shrubs and young trees on a Korean offshore island during spring migration in May; no people, buildings or text
views: adult, side view perched in a leafy shrub: long bright yellow supercilium, dark eye-stripe, uniform greenish-brown crown and upperparts with no crown stripe, plain wings with no wing-bars, bright lemon-yellow underparts from chin to undertail, fine bill with a blackish upper and orange lower mandible, pinkish-brown legs

adult, three-quarter front view perched on a twig: bright yellow supercilium and face, dark eye-stripe, yellow chin, throat and breast, yellowish belly, uniform greenish-brown upperparts, orange lower mandible
art.build: Small leaf warbler, smaller than a sparrow, slim with a rounded head and no crest. Bill fine and straight, shorter than the head. Legs slender, pale orange-brown. At rest the primary projection is short and the wingtips end well short of the tail tip. Tail medium length, square-ended. Forages low in bushes and scrub.
avoid: Do not add wing-bars; they mark Yellow-browed and Arctic warblers.
Do not paint buff or whitish underparts; the underparts are bright yellow throughout.
Do not give it a pale crown stripe (Eastern Crowned Warbler).
Do not paint a thick, stubby bill (Radde's Warbler, Phylloscopus schwarzi).
Do not paint blackish legs or an all-dark bill; the legs are pale orange-brown and the lower mandible orange-yellow.
